mentions.name: Goowee
mentions.description: A Go-to-WASM reactive UI framework called Goowee featuring fine-grained signals (no virtual DOM), components that run once, built-in SSR and hydration, and a small (~200-line) JS bridge. Still experimental, it has been used for the framework's own landing page and the author's other projects; the bet is that WASM is now fast enough and tooling mature enough that the fine-grained signal model avoids the VDOM overhead that held earlier Go UI frameworks back.
mentions.problem: Go UI frameworks have a long history of not quite getting there, held back by VDOM overhead and WASM limitations; the framework aims to solve that with fine-grained signals and modern WASM tooling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a Go to WASM reactive UI framework called Goowee. Fine grained signals (no VDOM), components run once, SSR and hydration built in. The JS bridge is about 200 lines.
